summary.en: Denser riffs, harder impact, subcultural identity.
summary.zh: 更密的 riff、更强的冲击与亚文化身份。

body.en: Metal splits from Hard Rock into its own aesthetic and community. Technique, force, and darker themes run in parallel as it enters mainstream view in the eighties.
body.zh: Metal 从 Hard Rock 中裂变，发展出独立的美学与社群。技巧、力度与主题黑暗化并行，并在 80 年代进入主流视野。
